title: Mishti Doi
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In a pot,add milk and bring it to boil then cook on flame low until reduced to half (20-25 minutes) and stir occasionally.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein doodh dal ker ubal lein phir halki ancch per adha reh janay tak paka lein (20-25 minutes) aur becb bech mein chamcha chalatay rahein.

steps.instruction: Remove from heat,add jaggery and mix well until jaggery is dissolved.
steps.romanUrdu: Chulhay sa hata lein aur gur dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.
Neem garam hunay tak thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: Transfer milk in clay pot,add 1-2 tsp of yogurt in each cup,mix well and cover with aluminum foil.
steps.romanUrdu: Doodh ko clay pot mein dal dein aur her cup mein 1-2 tsp dahi dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur aluminum foil sa dhak dein.

steps.instruction: In a pot,add water and bring it to boil,place steam rack and prepared clay pots,cover and steam cook on low flame for 20-25 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein pani dal ker ubal lein,steam rack rakh ker tayyar clay bowls rakh dein aur dhak ker halki ancch per 20-25 minutes kliya steam cook ker lein.

steps.instruction: Let it cool and chill in refrigerator & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Thanda karein aur refrigerator mein thanda ker lein & serve karein!

steps.instruction: Let it rest for 8 hours or overnight at room temperature & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: 8 hours ya overnight kliya room temperature per chor dein & serve karein!

ogDescription: A traditional Jaggary (Gur) sweetened yogurt, Mishti Doi / Dahi recipe. #HappyCookingToYou #FoodFusion
